title: stock — scrapping flow and SVL/valuation impact L3 depth

key_findings.title: No SVL model in Odoo 19
key_findings.description: stock.valuation.layer does not exist in Odoo 19. Inventory value is stored as the 'value' Monetary field on stock.move (stock_account/models/stock_move.py:24). Manual adjustment audit history is product.value model.

key_findings.title: Scrap uses usage=inventory not scrap_location boolean
key_findings.description: There is no scrap_location Boolean field on stock.location in Odoo 19. Scrap destinations are identified by usage='inventory' (Inventory Loss type). See stock_scrap.py:43-46.

key_findings.title: Scrap is classified as outgoing by _is_out()
key_findings.description: _is_out() returns True because source (internal) is valued and destination (inventory-loss) is not valued per _should_be_valued(). See stock_account/models/stock_move.py:575-583 and stock_account/models/stock_location.py:36-41.

key_findings.title: AVCO/Standard valuation: standard_price x qty
key_findings.description: For non-FIFO products: move.value = product.standard_price * move._get_valued_qty(). See stock_account/models/stock_move.py:351.

key_findings.title: FIFO valuation: consumes oldest in-move cost layers
key_findings.description: _run_fifo() in product.py:540-581 builds a stack of oldest in-moves (ordered date desc, reversed) and pops from front (oldest first), consuming proportional value from each receipt.

key_findings.title: Journal entry: Credit stock_valuation, Debit scrap expense
key_findings.description: _get_account_move_line_vals() at stock_account/models/stock_move.py:229-249: credit = product stock_valuation account; debit = scrap_location.valuation_account_id. Confirmed by test at test_stockvaluation.py:2843-2846.

key_findings.title: Account move requires real_time valuation and valuation_account on location
key_findings.description: _should_create_account_move() requires product.is_storable, is_valued, (location_dest_id.valuation_account_id or location_id.valuation_account_id), non-zero qty, product.valuation=='real_time'.

key_findings.title: No backorder for scrap
key_findings.description: In stock_move.py:2305-2308: if self.env.context.get('is_scrap'): return moves — backorder branch is entirely skipped. do_scrap() passes is_scrap=True context.

key_findings.title: Scrap is irreversible through standard UI
key_findings.description: _unlink_except_done() at stock_scrap.py:120-123 raises UserError for done scraps. No cancel or reverse method exists on stock.scrap.

key_findings.title: Multi-company isolation enforced in scrap location computation
key_findings.description: _compute_scrap_location_id() at stock_scrap.py:88-98 filters by company_id. location_id field has check_company=True. Prevents cross-company scrap.

notes: Odoo 19 architectural change: SVL removed, value on stock.move directly.
Scrap accounting requires scrap_location.valuation_account_id to be set.
FIFO scrap value pulled from _run_fifo() product method, consuming oldest layers.
do_scrap() is the canonical method; action_validate() is the UI entry point.
No cancel state exists on stock.scrap; done scraps are permanent.
